sources.title: Ecommerce UX Audit: How to Find What's Hurting Your Conversion
sources.takeaway: Checkout and shipping/tax surprises are leading abandonment drivers; audit against heuristics.

sources.title: Ecommerce UX That Converts: 2026 Guide
sources.takeaway: Reviews near add-to-cart, guest checkout, free-shipping progress.

sources.title: GEO for ecommerce: How to get your products cited by AI search engines
sources.takeaway: Complete Product schema, crawlable pages, answer-first copy.

sources.title: AEO/GEO playbook for Shopify brands
sources.takeaway: Brand-owned FAQs, policies, sizing guides are what AI cites.

sources.title: Generative Engine Optimization for Shopify
sources.takeaway: Allow AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot etc.); claims unverified by OpenAI docs.

sources.title: Build commerce agents with UCP
sources.takeaway: Shopify serves UCP discovery (/.well-known/ucp), an MCP endpoint, agents.md and llms.txt automatically; Shop MCP recommended for most agent builds. Confirms agentic surfaces are live by default on Basic.

sources.title: AI traffic quality: look past benchmarks and measure ROI
sources.takeaway: AI referrals are a small share of visits (Semrush ~0.14%, Ahrefs ~0.43%) but higher value per visit; advice is to measure your own AI referral ROI rather than trust category benchmarks.

sources.title: AI referral traffic statistics 2026: 16 studies
sources.takeaway: Roundup of 16 studies; AI referral share clusters 0.1-1% of traffic. Use only as a directional sanity check on GEO expectations; no primary data.

sources.title: Ecommerce product page best practices 2026
sources.takeaway: PDP essentials: multiple zoomable images and video, ratings near the title, visible return/shipping terms, mobile sticky add-to-cart, collapsed detail sections. Lift percentages are second-hand; treat as directional.

sources.title: Getting your first 100 orders for a DTC brand
sources.takeaway: 0-to-1 pattern: one customer problem, one promise, one hero product; first orders come from named people and nano-creator seeding; email every one of the first 100 buyers personally to collect proof and fix defects.

sources.title: AI Overviews and ecommerce traffic: 2026 data + plan
sources.takeaway: Cites a Visibility Labs study of 94 ecommerce brands finding ChatGPT referrals converting ~31% above non-branded organic. Secondary; unverified against the original.
